<script setup lang="ts">
// 日本語と🍣: "quoted" route targets
import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { definePage } from 'vue-router/experimental'
definePage({
  params: {
    query: { q: { parser: 'string', required: true }, page: { parser: 'int', format: 'value', default: 1 }, tags: { parser: 'string', format: 'array' }, at: { parser: 'date', format: 'value' } },
    hash: { heading: {} },
  },
})
const route = useRoute()
const router = useRouter()
const id: number = route.params.id
const q: string = route.params.q
const page: number = route.params.page
const tags: string[] | undefined = route.params.tags
const at: Date | undefined = route.params.at
const heading: string | undefined = route.params.heading
void router.push({ name: '/products/[id=int]', params: { id: 1, q: 'required' } })
void router.replace({ name: '/products/[id=int]', params: { id: 1, q: 'required' } })
const resolved = router.resolve({ name: '/products/[id=int]', params: { id: 1, q: 'required' } })
</script>
<template>
  <RouterLink :to="{ name: '/products/[id=int]', params: { id: 1, q: 'required' } }">Product</RouterLink>
  <RouterView />
  <div>{{ route.params.id.toFixed() }} {{ route.params.page.toFixed() }} {{ resolved.href }}</div>
</template>
